rules.intro: Filter articles with keywords or regular expressions
rules.title: Title
rules.creator: Author
rules.hint: Rules apply to newly fetched articles: all articles → group → source. Rules run from top to bottom; later actions take precedence. Drag and drop to reorder. Tests include rules from broader targets.
rules.saveError: Could not save rules. Please try again.
rules.blockHint: Hide new articles that match these keywords. Hidden articles can be shown again.
rules.keepHint: Hide new articles that do not match these keywords. Other blocking rules still apply.

rules.keywordHelp: Literal text, no regular expressions. Spaces within a phrase are preserved.

service.overwriteWarning: Local sources will be deleted if they exist in the service.

app.itemSize: Around {size} of local storage is occupied by articles
app.confirmImport: Do you really want to import data from the backup file? All current data will be wiped.
app.pacHint: For Socks proxies, it is recommended for PAC to return "SOCKS5" for proxy-side DNS. Turning off proxy requires restart.

personal.rulesLoadError: Rules could not be loaded. Original settings are preserved and reading remains available.
personal.searchHint: Search titles, feed text, full text and saved pages; separate terms with spaces
personal.searchShortcut: Press Ctrl+Shift+F for full-text search. F2 still opens keyword filtering.
personal.failed: Unable to complete this operation. Check your settings or retry:
personal.backupHint: Includes database, settings, rules, OPML and offline HTML. Scheduled backups run while the app is open; missed backups run at next launch. Restoring restarts the app.
personal.loginHint: Login windows, web view and full-text fetching share one session. You may need to sign in again when a website expires or revokes its session.
personal.addSiteRule: Add or update rule, then save settings
personal.networkHint: Defaults to a 5-second interval. Only one task per domain runs at a time.
personal.bulkHint: Only options changed here are applied. Choose Inherit to reset an override.
personal.inheritHint: Sources inherit their group settings. Individual overrides take precedence.
personal.offlineHint: Saves one HTML file with layout and downloadable images. Dynamic video and protected resources may be unavailable. Failed tasks can be retried here.
personal.offlineFailed: Offline saving failed. Check background tasks or retry.
personal.removeLaterOnRead: Remove from Read Later when opening or using single-article read shortcuts (card actions and batch operations preserve it)
personal.clearReadLater: Remove read articles from read later
personal.shortcutsHelp: F1 menu; F2 list search; Ctrl+Shift+F full-text search; F5 refresh; F6 organize articles; F7 messages; F8 view; F9 settings. Selected article: R read later; S star; M read/unread; B external browser; H hide; L webpage; W full text; left/right arrows previous/next; Esc close article or settings.

discovery.placeholder: Paste a website or RSS/Atom address
discovery.choose: Choose a feed to subscribe to:
discovery.noFeed: No advertised feed was found. You can look for a route on your RSSHub instance.

health.title: Subscription health
health.help: Check availability and permanent redirects. Background checks use your domain rate limit. Statistics count articles published in the past 30 days and actually opened during that period.
health.lowRate: You rarely open this subscription. Consider unsubscribing if it is no longer useful.
health.service: Managed by a sync service. Availability is checked by that service.
health.staleDays: Warn when no article appears for this many days

ai.help: Use an OpenAI-compatible chat API. Enter its base URL including /v1 when required, and its model name. Keys are encrypted with your Windows account. Local providers may work without a key. Enable AI per subscription; automatic features are off by default. Article text is sent to your chosen provider when these features run.
ai.keySaved: Saved securely — leave blank to keep
ai.hour: Briefing hour (local time, 0–23; catches up when the app opens)
ai.working: Processing… Long articles are processed in sections.
ai.unknownCalls: ({n} calls did not report complete usage)
ai.briefingHelp: Summarizes unread, visible articles published in the past 24 hours, grouped by topic. Previous briefings stay here.

refresh.timeout: Feed request timed out after 30 seconds.
refresh.explanation: Last refresh result. Zero new articles means no new entries were added; it does not mean the website has just published. Open notifications for failure details.
refresh.sourceTimes: Last successful fetch: {fetched} · Last check: {checked} · Latest stored publication: {published}
refresh.settingsHelp: Default: every 10 minutes while running. Startup and manual refresh always check feeds. When automatic refresh is enabled, returning to the app or reconnecting checks for overdue updates. Fully quitting stops collection; entries that disappear from the feed while closed may be missed.

organize.hoverSummary: Show article summary when hovering over a cover
organize.allMatches: All matches in this list, including unloaded articles
organize.dateHint: Publication date, local time. Both dates are inclusive; leave blank for no limit.
organize.topicHint: Organizes these articles only. Replaces their topic and preserves regular tags; subscriptions stay in place.
organize.saveRule: Also save the keyword filter and action as a rule
organize.ruleHint: Applies the keywords, fields, matching logic and subscription scope to future articles. Selection, dates and read/favorite status are not part of the rule.
organize.previewCount: {count} articles. Only this previewed set will be updated.
organize.partialFailure: Some articles may have been updated. Preview again before retrying.
organize.selectHint: Select without opening or marking read. Shift selects a range.
organize.filterHint: Toggle read articles. Hidden articles are controlled separately in the View menu.
organize.totalCount: Total, including read articles; respects this collection’s hidden-article setting
organize.expandList: Expand article list (hover at edge to preview)
organize.groupHint: Groups organize subscriptions. After creating one, select subscriptions below to add them. Empty groups also appear in the sidebar. Use Organize articles → Move to article topic for individual articles.
organize.addSources: Subscriptions to add to this group
organize.clearLaterConfirm: Remove {count} read articles from Read Later? Favorites and article content are preserved.
